description: This file defines the Currency class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages currency data, providing methods to format, convert, and retrieve information about different currencies stored in the database.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class that handles currency-related operations such as formatting, conversion, and retrieval of currency data from the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Currency object by loading currency data from the database through the registry.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a number into a currency string according to currency settings, including symbol placement and decimal formatting.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a monetary value from one currency to another based on their respective exchange rates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID associated with a specific currency code.

methods.name: getSymbolLeft
methods.description: Retrieves the left symbol of a specific currency.

methods.name: getSymbolRight
methods.description: Retrieves the right symbol of a specific currency.

methods.name: getDecimalPlace
methods.description: Retrieves the number of decimal places used for a specific currency.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the exchange rate value for a specific currency.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a specific currency is loaded and available.
